inlines.v: BLEE'DING, participle present tense Losing blood; letting blood; losing sap or juice. BLEE'DING, noun a running or issuing of blood, as from the nose; a hemorrhage; the operation of letting blood, as in surgery; the drawing of sap from a tree or plant.
